user.title: Tesla View
user.description: Tesla View renders your car in 3D from an **asset pack** you build yourself from a copy of the Tesla app with [tesla-view-extractor]({extractor_url}). You can upload the pack now or later via *Configure* ([how it works]({docs_url})).

data_description.pack_file: Optional. The tesla-view-pack-….zip produced by the extractor, up to 100 MB.

error.not_zip: The file is not a zip archive.
error.no_manifest: The zip has no manifest.json at its root – it is not a Tesla View asset pack.
error.unsupported_format: This pack uses a newer format than this version of Tesla View supports. Update the integration.
error.no_models: The pack contains no vehicle models.
error.bad_model_id: The pack contains an invalid model id.
error.unsafe_path: The pack contains unsafe file paths and was rejected.
error.too_large: The pack is too large to unpack.
error.missing_file: The pack is incomplete: files referenced by its manifest are missing.
error.unknown: Unexpected error – see the Home Assistant log.
